titulek: Russia strikes emergency hospital in Kharkiv, damaging MRI scan room – photos
shrnuti: Russian forces have attacked an emergency hospital in Kharkiv. A Russian drone has struck a room housing an MRI scanner. The scanner appears to have remained intact, but specialists will assess whether it is still functioning properly.
